```sql
WITH kosciusko_county AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Kosciusko County' AND border_type = 'county'
),
raster_subset AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM kosciusko_county),
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    r.rast,
    (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM kosciusko_county)
  )
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
  FROM raster_subset
)
SELECT
  MAX(value) AS max_slope_degrees
FROM (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(slope_rast)).*
  FROM slope_raster
) AS dump;
```
